correctness.sourceChecks: The 11 canonical benchmark files are byte-identical in both checkouts; graph, streaming, and metadata fixture helpers are checked separately.
correctness.method: Go AST instrumentation of the exact benchmark cases, executed with 1x instead of collecting timings. Observer calls are excluded from the saved timing measurements.
observed: Screen characters, widths, foreground/background colors, font and underline attributes, and links
View content, raw cell styles, metadata, writer position, and pending newline
Text content, wrapping, layout coordinates, and cursor/origin state
Search result coordinates and selected result
Selected paths, range bounds, tree structure, file ordering, and recovery index
correctness.scope: Equivalence of the benchmark fixtures and recorded traces, not a proof covering all application inputs.
